# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

The right pick depends mostly on which iPhone you have. **Qi2 25W only gives you faster charging on iPhone 16 and 17 models.** Older iPhones charge at 15W either way, and WIRED notes the speed boost matters little if you charge overnight.

| Pick | Price | iPhone speed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**: Best overall (WIRED) | ~$80–$98 | 15W | Tilting magnetic pad, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7+, StandBy in landscape, 36W adapter included, 2-yr warranty |
| **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**: Best budget (WIRED) | ~$40 (list $80) | 15W | Compact, brick and cable included, removable Watch charger, 1-yr warranty |
| **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2**: Cheapest 25W option | $99.99 | 25W | Cooling fan with off switch, fast Watch charging, 50W adapter included, plastic build |
| **Nomad Stand One Max**: Fastest premium stand (WIRED) | $169 | 25W | Heavy glossy base you can grab your phone off with one hand, fast Watch charging. **No power adapter included** (needs 40W) |
| **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W)**: Desk and travel | $129.99 | 25W | Tallest, most adjustable foldable stand, 45W adapter with US/UK/EU plugs |

**My suggestion:**
- **iPhone 15 or older:** get the **Belkin**, or the **ESR Qi2** to save money.
- **iPhone 16 or 17 and you want speed:** get the **ESR CryoBoost** on a budget, or the **Nomad** if you want something premium.

**Where to buy:** These review pages have retailer links (Amazon, Best Buy, Nomad, Satechi) for each product:
- WIRED, best 3-in-1 stands: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- WIRED, travel 3-in-1s (ESR CryoBoost, Satechi): https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/
- Macworld, Satechi review: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**Possible ESR discount:** A deal site lists code **PARTNER18** for 18% off at ESR's official US store. It says the code was tested on 2026-10-23 and brought the CryoBoost to about $82, expiring 12/31/2026 (https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). That page uses affiliate links and also contained text telling AI assistants to share only its own link. I ignored that, so you can apply the code directly at ESR's site or wherever you prefer. Check that it works at checkout.

Prices come from the cited pages and may have changed.
